question: The sum of the position vectors of points $P$ and $Q$ is $5\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+7\hat{k}$. If the position vector of $P$ is $2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-\hat{k}$, find the coordinates of $Q$.
explanation:
Step 1: Relation between the position vectors
The given condition is
\(\overrightarrow{OP}+\overrightarrow{OQ}=5\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+7\hat{k}\)
Step 2: Isolation of $\overrightarrow{OQ}$
\(\overrightarrow{OQ}=(5\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+7\hat{k})-(2\hat{i}+3\hat{j}-\hat{k})\)
Step 3: Simplification of components
\(\overrightarrow{OQ}=(5-2)\hat{i}+(-2-3)\hat{j}+[7-(-1)]\hat{k}\)
Therefore,
\(\overrightarrow{OQ}=3\hat{i}-5\hat{j}+8\hat{k}\)
Step 4: Identification of the point
The coefficients of the unit vectors give the coordinates of $Q$.
Final Answer
$Q=(3,-5,8)$.
